provider.description: `local` when the project doesn't have a provisioned repository yet.

provisioningStatus.description: `null` when the bootstrap never started. Derived from the cursor.

budget.description: `null` when the project NEVER had a budget set — distinct from a zeroed-out row, and this is what makes the card offer "Set budget".

latestSeq.description: Last `seq` already recorded in the most recent session (`nextSeq - 1`); 0 when there is no session. The web compares this against what has already been seen to count unread.

lastEvent.description: The most recent session's last event — the card's footer line.

seq.description: Order within the session. Monotonic and gapless.

type.description: Event type. The full inventory is in `docs/reference/events.md`.

id.description: The user's id when `kind=user`; the agent's slug when `kind=agent`.

payload.description: Free-form shape, specific to each `type`. See the events reference.

storiesAwaitingPromotion.description: Stories the PO finished and that are awaiting the user's promotion (RN-048).

pendingApprovalsCount.description: `proposed_actions` with `status = pending` across the WHOLE project, all sessions — not just the most recent one. This is what the sidebar shows as the project's badge (RN-151).

onlineAgentCount.description: How many agents are ONLINE right now — working or with a pending item awaiting a decision (RN-409). Never team size: an `idle`/`idle_tripped` dev agent does not count, an `idle` conversational agent does not count, QA/SecOps never count (single verdict per invocation).

executionActivated.description: The most recent session has already recorded `execution.activated` — this is what brings per-module dev agents into the roster.

moduleNames.description: Module names from the CURRENT module_map (highest `version`). One dev agent per module, once execution has been activated.

gatesEverOpened.description: Some PR gate (dev or infra) has opened AT LEAST ONCE in this session — this is what brings QA and SecOps into the roster. Covers the whole session, not a window of the last N events.

delegatedSubagents.description: Subagents with at least one delegation recorded in the session, whatever the outcome — dismissal is a recorded decision, not silence.

infraActive.description: An `accepted` handoff to `infra` exists in the most recent session.

uxDesignerActive.description: An `accepted` handoff to `ux-designer` exists in the most recent session (ADR 0087).

staffActive.description: An `accepted` handoff to `staff` exists in the most recent session (docs/fluxo.yml, ADR 0088) — dormant for automatic triggering, only reflects an already-accepted MANUAL activation.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Workspace doesn't exist or is invisible to the caller.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
